meta.title: MIC Agency — Grow your sales through Meta Ads
meta.description: MIC Agency is a team specialized exclusively in Meta Ads. Audience research, creative testing, and optimization built to grow your sales.

hero.kicker: A team specialized in Meta Ads
hero.headline: We grow your business sales through Meta Ads
hero.subtext: MIC Agency doesn't do everything — it does one thing: find the audience on Meta that's ready to buy, and turn them into real customers.
hero.proofLine: One service. Full focus. Clear results.

services.title: Meta Ads — one service, a complete system
services.subtitle: Every campaign is built on a four-stage system — not random targeting.

items.title: Audience research
items.text: We identify the people who genuinely intend to buy your product — based on purchase intent, not just age or interests.

items.title: Creative testing
items.text: We test several ad variations at once and keep only the ones that perform.

items.title: Campaign management
items.text: We track budget daily and push it toward whatever is driving sales — hands-on, not on autopilot.

items.title: Transparent reporting
items.text: You get a weekly report with exact numbers: spend, leads generated, and cost per lead.

items.title: Meta Ads only
items.text: We don't do SMM, branding, or design. The entire team is focused on one thing — growing sales through Meta Ads.

items.title: Strategy, not templates
items.text: Every business gets its own approach. No pre-built templates, no generic campaigns.

items.title: Fast communication
items.text: You get answers in hours, not days, and stay informed on campaign status at all times.

items.title: Full transparency
items.text: You always know exactly where your budget is going — no hidden costs.

process.title: How we work
process.subtitle: Four clear stages — from the first conversation to consistent results.

steps.title: Free consultation
steps.text: We discuss your business, goals, and current situation.

steps.title: Strategy
steps.text: We build a targeting strategy and budget plan for your industry.

steps.title: Launch
steps.text: Campaigns go live and creatives are put through testing.

steps.title: Optimization
steps.text: We monitor results continuously and reallocate budget to what performs best.

cta.title: Ready to grow your sales?
cta.text: In a free consultation, we'll map out the right strategy for your business together. No obligation.
